args.query: Enable the documented annual offer by changing pricing.json only. Preserve the monthly offer, currency, and refund policy. Leave preview.mjs and all documentation unchanged. Also return the annual price, monthly price, and refund window with source citations.

passages.excerpt:
## Cancellation and refunds

Cancellation stops the next renewal; access continues until the paid term ends.
The refund request window is 14 calendar days after the initial payment.
Changing the billing period must preserve that refund window.

## D-002 — accepted

The accepted annual price is 19000 euro cents per seat, replacing D-001.
Notify by email only after the third failed retry; intermediate retries are silent.
Switching from monthly to annual takes effect at the next renewal date.
There is no immediate prorated charge when requesting that switch.

## Accepted offers

The monthly subscription costs 1900 euro cents per seat.
The annual subscription costs 19000 euro cents per seat for twelve months.
The annual offer uses the configuration key stripe_price_annual_studio.
All offers are denominated in EUR.

# Northstar subscriptions

This synthetic project manages subscriptions for a design studio.
The current billing policy is in docs/billing.md.
Accepted decisions supersede drafts and archived decisions.
Amounts are integer euro cents. Provider identifiers are configuration keys.

To preview the configured offers, run `node preview.mjs`.
The preview reads pricing.json; only that configuration needs changing to
enable an offer whose terms are already documented.

## D-001 — archived

Status: superseded by D-002.
The early proposal priced the annual subscription at 22800 euro cents per seat.
The proposal sent an email after every failed payment.
